name: Euro stacking container 400 x 300 x 150 mm
description:
A solid-walled euro stacking container on the 400 x 300 mm footprint: exactly half the 600 x 400 euro module, so eight fit a 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer and two sit side by side in the footprint of a full-size crate. This is the small-parts member of the family, used for order picking, kitting and line-side supply where a full 600 x 400 crate is more than the part needs.

External dimensions: length 400 mm, width 300 mm, height 150 mm.

400 x 300 mm footprint: half the 600 x 400 module, eight per 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer. 150mm is the consumer rounding of the VDA 4500 grid height of 147.5mm.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 2,484 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Euro stacking container, 400 x 300 x 150 mm - true-scale GLB of the half-module European small load carrier.
